mcq.q: Blade ka `{{ }}` output ke saath kya karta hai?
Khali list ke liye kaunsa directive best hai?
mcq.why: `@forelse` ke `@empty` section se khali list handle hoti hai.

mcq.q: Component mein PHP variable pass karne ke liye kya likhte hain?
mcq.why: Colon wala `:prop` PHP expression leta hai.
Subfolder ko dot se likhte hain.

mcq.q: Layout mein child ka script daalne ke liye kya use hota hai?
mcq.why: Child `@push('scripts')` karta hai, layout `@stack('scripts')` se dikhata hai.

mcq.q: `@vite` lagaya par 'Vite manifest not found' aaye to kya karein?
options: `npm run dev` ya `npm run build` chalao
mcq.why: Assets build nahi hue, to `npm run dev` ya `build` chalana padta hai.

assignments.title: Product card component
tasks: Ek page par 3 cards `@foreach` se dikhao
assignments.explain: `@props` data leta hai, `$slot` tag ke andar ka content.

assignments.title: Layout ke saath multi-page site
assignments.brief: Ek layout component se do pages banao.
tasks: Har page ka alag title `<x-slot:title>` se do
Layout mein `@stack('scripts')` jodo aur ek page se script push karo
assignments.explain: Layout ek baar banta hai, har page sirf apna content deta hai.

interview.a: Laravel ka template engine. Templates plain PHP mein compile hokar cache hote hain.
`{{ }}` escape karta hai (XSS se bachav), `{!! !!}` raw output deta hai.
`@foreach` ke andar milne wala object jisme iteration, index, first, last, even, odd, count jaisi properties hoti hain.
Anonymous sirf Blade file hota hai, class-based mein PHP class bhi hoti hai jo logic deti hai.
Component ke andar ka content. Default slot `$slot`, naam wale slots `<x-slot:name>` se.

interview.q: How do you create a custom Blade directive?
interview.a: `Blade::directive()` ko service provider ke `boot()` mein register karke, phir `view:clear` chalate hain.
